bundle.shortDescription: Offline knowledge library with a local AI assistant
bundle.longDescription: Museion keeps a curated reference library on your own disk and runs a language model locally on top of it. Ask a question in plain language and get an answer drawn from your library, with citations you can open and read yourself. No internet, no account, nothing leaves the machine.
